**App Name:** QuiltOS

**What it does:** A decentralized productivity suite where users create "cells" (14-tuple data structures) that bind together documents, effects, views, and timelines. Each cell acts as a living document with its own address, forming a 4D graph of interconnected knowledge. Real-time collaboration through witness logs records every interaction.

**Who uses it:** Remote teams, researchers, and knowledge workers who need to manage complex, evolving projects across multiple dimensions while maintaining complete audit trails.
